studies.title: The Mercator projection
studies.caption: Gerardus Mercator draws the world so that any line of constant compass bearing is straight.
studies.prompt: Close worktable view in Duisburg1569, cartographer drawing a world chart with straight perpendicular meridians and parallels spaced increasingly apart toward top and bottom; brass dividers and straightedge. Manuscript working sketch, no modern digital cartography or readable labels.
